methodology.cache: Fresh process and output directory per sample; warm filesystem caches; no incremental/result cache reuse.
methodology.ordering: Sequential, deterministically rotating tool order each round.
methodology.timing: Wall clock: process startup, imports, reads, generation, writes and disposal. Zig inference includes the published project planner, dependency snapshots and context serialization; native Zig performs inference and emission. Cleanup and qualification excluded.
methodology.correctness: Every sample strictly consumed with TypeScript 6 and skipLibCheck=false. All module exports exercised, including parameter types, arity and default optionality. Two negative assignments require exactly TS2322. Inferred API positions additionally reject any and preserve widening. Bundles checked standalone.
methodology.scope: No type annotations: inferred parameter defaults, return objects, arrow functions, class members, mutable objects, arrays and imported function results. No JSX, dependencies, watch or declaration maps. Not proof of arbitrary TypeScript equivalence.

groups.project-emit: Per-module declarations without a required semantic check.
groups.checked-project: Includes semantic checking. Do not rank against unchecked emitters.
groups.bundled-project: Standalone declaration entry. Extra typechecking/JavaScript work varies by tool; see adapters.
